Delivery status is recorded for reliability. Central catalogue prices are indicative only, and MED+250 does not publish pharmacy-specific prices or stock. Opening a pharmacy chat or the phone's MoMo menu leaves MED+250 and is governed by the relevant service and your mobile operator. MED+250 does not process or hold the payment.
